title: MIDNIGHT PINBALL
description: Original 80s arcade pinball: tall scrolling tables, upper flippers, target banks, lane combos and three-ball multiball. Load a library of PBT tables from SD without reflashing.

buttons.action: Launch in shooter lane; shake left during play
Tap to launch at fixed power
Shake right; four rapid shakes tilt
Pause; hold 3 seconds for CHGame menu
